description: e2000fs_calib11h_noenlil. Single-axis ablation of the board leader e2000fs_calib11g_serarounds2: the two ENLIL columns of the frozen Top30, enlil_n_pending (number of WSA-Enlil Earth-arrival predictions still pending at the origin, vintage rule modelCompletionTime <= origin) and enlil_kp (max Kp over those pending runs), leave the design; every other element is the parent verbatim - SERA relevance weights on the metric's velocity-space measure w=(y-q0)/(q100-q0) per lead, median-anchored, level target, three 24-h vector-leaf boosters per period, per-period rounds F1/F2 300 and F3 1200, depth 3, seed 42, 144 h maturity mask, 19 constant + 24 h x 9 varying = 235 columns instead of 237. Motivation: on the parent's F1 block-0 booster the two columns take 79 + 96 of 3,718 constant-feature splits, but permuting them at prediction time moves RMSE by -0.39 / +1.22 km/s and refitting without them moves F1 h1-24 RMSE by -1.0 / -0.9 / -1.3 km/s over seeds 42/43/44 - inside seed noise, with no measured gain, so the ENLIL metadata carry no information the ACE/CH/27-day block does not already carry. No routing, no gate, no blend, no post-processing. F1/F2/F3 use cutoffs 2025-12-29 / 2026-03-29 / 2026-06-29 and 72 h target maturity; all 6,315 origins are forecast unconditionally. MEASURED: TOTAL S 101.224 (parent 99.093), TIMSE 23,431.3 (22,579.7), RMSE 68.691 (66.898), F1 S 121.973 (120.871), F2 S 76.576 (75.103), F3 S 64.828 (60.960). The prediction-time probe that motivated the arm (F1 block 0, -0.39/+1.22 km/s under permutation, -1.0/-0.9/-1.3 km/s under refit over seeds 42/43/44) does not extend to the official periods: the two ENLIL metadata columns are worth 2.13 points of TOTAL S and 3.87 points of F3 S, so the arm is recorded as a REJECTED single-axis ablation and is submitted as evidence, not as a candidate. Both arms fit the same per-period round counts (F3 1200; the parent's published F3 block 0 is reproduced bit-exactly at 1200 rounds, max abs diff 0.0), so the difference is the feature axis alone.

data.feature_set: df.parquet frozen Top30 minus the two ENLIL columns (19 constant + 24 h x 9 varying per block = 235 columns); identical to the parent otherwise
data.parent_feature_set: df.parquet Top30 (21 constant + 24 h x 9 varying per block), 237 columns

ablation.change: remove enlil_n_pending and enlil_kp from the 21 constant features

objective.family: SERA relevance-weighted squared error (per-row, per-lead weights), identical to the parent
objective.weights: w_i = (y_i - q0)/(q100 - q0) per lead, median-anchored; labels only
objective.rho_source: none; the SERA weights need no calibration block and no fitted scalar
objective.estimand: E[w(Y)Y|x]/E[w(Y)|x] = probability-weighted mixture of conditional tail means

booster.rounds_selection: inherited from the parent (rolling-origin argmin on the quarter ending immediately before each period's training cutoff)

hyperparameters.post_processing: none (no clipping, no calibration lane, no blend)
